held.title: `Kysely` and `DB` are used as types, but this change adds no import for them.
held.body: The new `let db: Kysely<DB>;` needs both `Kysely` and `DB` in scope. Going by the line counts in CHANGES (+36), every added line is in these two hunks, so no import was added. The old code used `const db = await getKyselyDB()` with no type annotation, so the file may never have imported these names. If it didn't, `tsc` / the server type-check step fails. Vitest strips types, so the test still runs and the failure only shows up in type-check CI. I couldn't see the file's imports to confirm. Fix: add `import { Kysely } from 'kysely';` and import `DB` from the schema module if they are missing, or write `let db: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getKyselyDB>>;`.
